offering_description.value: Brown & Brown is an insurance intermediary that places property and casualty, employee benefits and specialty insurance for businesses, public entities, and individuals. It also provides program administration, wholesale brokerage and related services through retail offices and specialty units.

primary_services.value: retail insurance brokerage; wholesale insurance brokerage; managed programs and specialty program administration; employee benefits consulting; flood insurance claims and outsourced services

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial businesses, associations, and retail agents using wholesale and program services; B2C: individuals buying personal lines, flood and life/health coverage; B2G: public entities and government-related programs such as flood insurance

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; employee benefits; personal insurance; construction; public sector; real estate

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies placed, including contingent commissions; service fees: fees for consulting, claims processing, program administration and risk management
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places coverage from insurance carriers for retail clients and via wholesale to other agents; service provider: administers programs and handles claims and benefits services for clients and carriers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with operations in the UK, Canada, Ireland, Bermuda and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: retail brokerage, wholesale brokerage, programs, and services all centered on insurance distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: producers in local retail offices selling to commercial and individual clients; agents / brokers: wholesale brokerage sold through independent retail agents, program business via agents; own locations: network of local branch offices
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance producer licensing by state insurance departments and international regulators, also fiduciary and benefits rules
